ACCOUNT_DATA_TRANSFER.TITLE: Export / Import data
ACCOUNT_DATA_TRANSFER.DESCRIPTION: Move professionals, services, payers, contacts, conversations with their attachments, appointments and waitlist entries between instances. Does not include automations (triggers, welcome bot, templates); those get configured fresh on each instance.
ACCOUNT_DATA_TRANSFER.FETCH_ERROR: Could not load the export/import information.

EXPORT.TITLE: Export this account
EXPORT.DESCRIPTION: Generates a downloadable .zip with all of this account's data.
EXPORT.STARTED: Export started. It runs in the background.

IMPORT.TITLE: Import into this account
IMPORT.DESCRIPTION: Upload a .zip exported from another instance. Always additive: never deletes or replaces existing data.
IMPORT.STARTED: Import started. It runs in the background.
